provenance.note: The pooled shape's cluster-robust variance by date: the score of each exceedance with respect to the shape (the scale moving with it as the mean excess times 1 - xi) plus the name-level correction for the estimated mean excess, summed by day and squared, over the squared curvature, with numerical derivatives written independently of the module's closed forms; and the delete-a-block jackknife over six blocks of days with the thresholds re-estimated. Series are a one-factor Student t world.
